title: Sable and the Salt
author: A. M. Delacroix
blurb: Juniper Ashgrove, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
